title: Data Engineer
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Mid-level Data Engineer to build and maintain dbt pipelines and Snowflake data marts behind customer‑facing reporting, spend analytics, and AI features.

The mandatory requirements are solid dbt experience (modeling, tests, macros, and incremental models), ingestion and orchestration tools such as Airbyte or Prefect, 3+ years in data or analytics engineering on production pipelines, strong SQL and Python, dimensional modeling, Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse, and an upper‑intermediate English level.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and maintain the dbt pipelines, data marts, and warehouse models that serve in‑app reporting, spend analytics, AI features, and internal analytics, treating them as production systems.
  • Translate complicated procurement business logic into maintainable, well‑tested pipeline code, and notice when a model is valid‑looking but wrong.
  • Build models within our data mart architecture, following the chapter's conventions for grain, conformed dimensions, and incremental patterns, and propose improvements when you find them.
  • Contribute to and help buildout the semantic layer that our internal MCP servers and AI agents query, so metrics and dimensions are defined once and answered consistently.
  • Maintain the boundary between PII and agent/reporting‑safe data.
  • Build and maintain the FastAPI services that expose reporting marts to customers.
  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines (Airbyte, OneSchema, S3) into the warehouse, and support our Forward Deployed Engineering function in bringing customer data into our systems.
  • Implement data quality checks: freshness, schema and reconciliation tests, and alerting, so problems surface before customers find them.
  • Implement metric definitions faithfully, and flag conflicting or ambiguous definitions to the chapter rather than guessing.
  • Keep documentation and lineage current so that humans and AI agents can both find and trust what's in the warehouse.
  • Tune Snowflake performance and cost within the models you build.
  • Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, within the guardrails (tests, conventions, review patterns) the team maintains, and understand why those guardrails exist.
  • Share what you learn through code review and team discussion.
  • Communicate clearly with engineering, product, and customer‑facing teams about what the data means and what it can and can't do.

MUST HAVES

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related role, including hands‑on work on production data pipelines that other systems or customers depended on.
  • Solid dbt experience: modeling, tests, macros, and incremental models.
  • Strong SQL and working Python.
  • Data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, data marts, grain and conformance.
  • Experience with a modern cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred).
  • Experience with ingestion tooling and orchestration (Airbyte, Prefect, or equivalents).
  • Familiarity with agentic coding tools and an understanding of why guardrails around their output matter.
  • Deep curiosity about the business: you want to understand what the data means and how customers use it, not just how it flows.
  • Software engineering discipline for analytics code: Git, code review, CI/CD.
  • Can take a multi‑sprint piece of work from spec to production with normal oversight, and can explain tradeoffs to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience building or maintaining API services on top of warehouse data (FastAPI or similar).
  • Experience with a semantic layer or governed metric definitions that multiple consumers rely on, including for LLM‑driven or agent‑driven querying.
  • Experience exposing warehouse data to customers through embedded analytics or customer‑facing APIs.
  • Experience with data observability tooling.
  • Experience supporting customer data onboarding or implementation teams.
  • Experience deploying data pipelines across multiple regions and managing PII or sensitive data.
  • Knowledge of procurement and/or supply chain data models.
  • Prior experience in enterprise software and startups.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Data Engineer (Marketing‑oriented) | Remote for Marketing Agency for Education

Our client is a fast‑growing performance marketing agency specializing in mission‑driven organizations across higher education and nonprofit sectors. Since launching in 2020, the agency has built a strong reputation for combining strategic thinking, creative execution, and data‑driven marketing to help universities and organizations achieve measurable growth.

Company Overview

Our client is a fast‑growing performance marketing agency specializing in mission‑driven organizations across higher education and nonprofit sectors. Since launching in 2020, the agency has built a strong reputation for combining strategic thinking, creative execution, and data‑driven marketing to help universities and organizations achieve measurable growth.

Your Role

The Senior Data Engineer sits at the center of the agency's Data and Analytics function, connecting every paid media platform and CRM the agency touches into a single, reliable source of truth. You'll own the full path data takes: from a client's ad accounts and CRM, through Adverity, into a BigQuery warehouse, through modular dbt/Dataform transformations, and out to the Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports the team and its partners rely on daily. Reporting to the Data and Analytics Manager, you're joining at a pivotal moment — the agency is scaling its roster of education and nonprofit partners, and this role is instrumental in evolving the automated reporting suite that makes that growth possible without sacrificing data quality or client trust.

You'll

  • Own data ingestion & pipeline architecture — connect and maintain API pipelines from paid media platforms (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic) into Adverity, build custom Python connectors for anything not natively supported, and architect scalable pipelines from source system through to dashboard
  • Own CRM integration — build and maintain reliable CRM data connections (Slate, Salesforce, HubSpot) so lead and enrollment data flows cleanly into the warehouse
  • Own the data warehouse — route, optimize, and store raw and processed data in Google BigQuery; design efficient schemas for complex, multi‑source marketing data (granularity, normalization, slowly changing dimensions); manage partitioning, clustering, and storage strategy to control query cost and performance
  • Own transformation & mapping — build SQL schemas that map, blend, and organize multi‑channel data accurately for each client, in modular, version‑controlled, documented dbt or Dataform pipelines, with standardized naming conventions and metric definitions across platforms and clients
  • Own CI/CD & data segregation — maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, automated testing) for robust, version‑controlled releases, and enforce strict data segregation across multi‑client environments
  • Enable the reporting layer — create clean, performant data views built specifically for fast Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports, and partner with the Data and Analytics Manager and client teams to translate reporting requirements into warehouse models
  • Drive data quality — monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands‑on data engineering experience, ideally in a marketing or agency environment
  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)
  • Intermediate to advanced SQL, with proven BigQuery experience in transformation, partitioning, and modeling
  • Expertise in dbt or Dataform, managing modular, version‑controlled, documented SQL transformation pipelines
  • Python proficiency for custom API connections and pipeline automation
  • Experience with CRM data flows and integrations (Slate, Salesforce, and/or HubSpot)
  • A deep understanding of marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC) and paid platform schemas, with a proven track record of structuring data to optimize Looker Studio performance
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi‑client data environments with strict data segregation
  • An analytical, solution‑driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non‑technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points

  • Experience integrating AI‑driven insights or machine learning models into marketing data pipelines to sharpen predictive analytics and data utility
  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows
  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture
  • Experience using AI/ML‑driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

What’s Offered

  • Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async‑friendly team
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location
  • A pivotal, high‑visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the agency's reporting infrastructure
  • The chance to build the data backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world
  • A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A‑players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal
  • Direct impact: the pipelines and models you build directly shape how partners see (and trust) their own performance data

Interview Process

  • Application Review (resume + a few questions)
  • Screening Call with Atomic HR
  • Hiring Team Interview (walkthrough of a pipeline or data model you've built)
  • Technical Assessment (a real‑world data engineering case study)

title: Aesthetics Engineer,  Look Development
description:
iPhone is the most popular camera in the world, and Aesthetics Science is focused on understanding human perception and artistic intent with enough precision for scientists, engineers, designers and artists to work on it together. This role joins a team that strives to understand why people take pictures and what they like about them, in order to infuse that knowledge directly into the software development process. We are feature developers who bring rigorous research and photographic principles to how Apple builds the camera and visual experiences that people rely on every day.

The Aesthetics Engineer role is integrated into camera algorithm teams and is responsible for creating and polishing the highest caliber of visual aesthetics. Using specialized internal software tools, your work translates image processing algorithms and varied research techniques into practical look and feel.

The Aesthetics Engineer authors the look and is accountable for its distinctiveness, repeatability and cultural relevance of its intention. They are able to collect many diverse perspectives across a subjective space and are comfortable with a creative process involving complex and fast-paced iterative feedback loops. The successful candidate partners with engineering, design, art and science experts to create, refine and uphold the aesthetics look and feel throughout the development process from ideation to shipping.

Minimum Qualifications

  • A subject-matter expert in contemporary photography and photographic aesthetics with a demonstrated portfolio and proven track record to create these aesthetics at capture and in post-production for commercial or editorial publishing.
  • Published portfolio establishing clear subject-matter expertise and hands-on input in creating a mainstream genre of photography at the highest caliber commercial, editorial or art industry standards. Portfolio demonstrates professional image techniques, commercial creative production, or large-scale look development on deadline, references may be requested.
  • Exceptional proficiency in utilizing complex internal tooling and software interfaces for image tuning and look development
  • Ability and interest in learning software and hardware image processing pipelines in order to identify opportunities for computational look development solutions and parameters optimization.
  • Flexibility to travel when needed.
  • Excellent written and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in photographic post-production, creative visual production, on-site field production
  • Experience with various editing software packages, cameras, film and digital systems, professional capture and edit workflows, set experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with and evaluate complex, early-stage prototype software, with a strong aptitude for finding drawbacks, debugging visual issues, and isolating exactly which controls or parameters are causing specific problems
  • Demonstrated experience with managing software development production processes (from a tuning, QA, and creative feedback perspective) and collaborating with cross-functional technical teams.

title: WIOA Career Coach - Contra Costa County
description:
Location: Concord,California,United States

CAREER COACH

The Career Coach (WIOA) reports to the WIOA Team Supervisor and serves on a team of Career Coaches providing employment services to economically disadvantaged populations through the Contra Costa Workforce Collaborative's Active Collaboration Through Innovation, Opportunities, and Networking (ACTION) model.
This is a full-time, non-exempt position.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Case management/Coaching: Conduct intake interviews, eligibility determination, pre-employment preparation, and advocacy; ensure participant accesses all needed services. Assess participant needs and collaborate with the participant to develop and follow a self-sufficiency plan; motivate the participant to achieve career goals and provide the participant with honest, productive feedback.
  • Job placement and retention: Develop employer contacts and referral sources and generate job leads; market services; make job placements and provide post-placement support to participants and employers; participate in employer recruitment events; job fairs, and networking events.
  • Developing Partnerships: Work with the local department of Probation and other community partners focused on supporting justice-impacted individuals to coordinate services and effectively provide wrap-around support and document participant progress.
  • Group facilitation/instruction: Facilitate workshops, discussion groups and/or classes on employment readiness topics including but not limited to resume development, job search skills, career assessment, exploration and planning.
  • Data management: Develop a strong understanding of standard operating procedures; Document customer interactions using CRM systems, including Cal Jobs, and protect and maintain customer confidentiality and case record compliance.


COMPETENCIES

  • Solid job development, career coaching and case management experience and expertise.
  • Teamwork, interpersonal flexibility, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to inspire others; Ability to maintain professional partnerships and relations.
  • Solid workshop facilitation skills and abilities.
  • Computer and internet literacy, including Microsoft Office proficiency, experience with CRM systems helpful.
  • Cultural Responsiveness and an alignment with our values and commitment to equity and inclusion.
  • This position requires occasional travel throughout East Contra Costa County and other Rubicon meetings; if the employee opts to meet these travel requirements by driving, proof of a valid and current driver's license, current auto insurance, and an acceptable Motor Vehicle Report are required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

  • $25-28/hr DOE.
  • Medical, Dental and Vision health plans. Kaiser and Sutter Health options.
  • 3 weeks paid vacation and sick leave, 13 paid holidays.
  • 4 days paid restorative holiday between Christmas and New Years.
  • Employer sponsored retirement plan.

About Rubicon

An $18M non-profit Rubicon, provides direct services at eight locations in Alameda and Contra Costa counties and operates a growing commercial landscape social enterprise program that is a leader in sustainable practices. Rubicon transforms East Bay communities by equipping people to break the cycle of poverty. Recognized as a national leader in workforce development, Rubicon provides individualized one-on-one career advising, job search support, financial education, wellness and legal services, to very low-income people who face significant barriers to achieving economic mobility.

Rubicon is a 2022 Great Place to Work, on a journey towards becoming a high-road employer and an anti-racist organization. We are committed to systems change and advocacy through efforts like expanding and deepening Employee Resource Groups; the launch of an internal Racial Justice Task Force; and implementation of talent and culture supports that acknowledge and facilitate healing from the direct and indirect effects of racial trauma.

Rubicon actively recruits staff members with a diversity of culture, thought, and lived experiences who are not only highly skilled, but who consistently demonstrate a commitment to our vision of an East Bay without poverty and are passionate about this work.

Rubicon is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and values diversity of culture, thought, and lived experiences. We seek talented, qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, marital status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, conviction history, uniform service membership/veteran status, physical or mental disability, protected medical conditions, genetic characteristics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression regardless of physical gender, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

Rubicon uses E-Verify to validate the eligibility of our new employees to work legally in the United States.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Experience: 5+ Years
Location: Hyderabad /Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time

About ServCrust
ServCrust is a fast-growing D2C SaaS platform reshaping the construction materials and logistics ecosystem using AI-led supply chain intelligence, geo-analytics, and credit-risk insights.
We process real-time order, logistics, and IoT data across multiple states to deliver insights on pricing, supplier performance, delivery optimization, and more

Role Overview
We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to build and scale our end-to-end data pipelines that power dashboards, AI models, and decision systems across our microservices-driven architecture.
You’ll collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure our logistics, geo-commerce, and operations data remains clean, reliable, and highly actionable.

What You’ll Do
  • Build and maintain data pipelines for logistics, pricing, and operational intelligence using Kafka streaming and structured ETL workflows.
  • Design and optimize data models supporting dashboards, forecasting engines, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Integrate data from PostgreSQL, IoT devices, microservices, and external APIs into unified data warehouses.
  • Implement data quality checks, schema evolution, and lineage tracking for reliable analytics.
  • Work with backend teams to embed data services into Spring Boot microservices using AWS-native tools.
  • Manage AWS data infrastructure: RDS, Glue, S3, Athena, Redshift, QuickSight.
  • Contribute to real-time dashboards for delivery tracking, credit monitoring, and supplier insights.
  • Ensure data security, governance, and observability aligned with ISO 27001 & SOC 2 practices.
  • Support data architecture planning for scaling AI-enabled OMS and credit systems.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS, Data Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering & pipeline development.
  • Strong expertise in SQL (PostgreSQL) and Python (Pandas / PySpark).
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka, AWS (Glue, S3, RDS, Athena, Lambda), and ETL orchestration tools (Airflow / Step Functions).
  • Proficiency in building data marts and OLAP models.
  • Experience with API-based ingestion and microservice data flows.
  • Understanding of data governance, RBAC, and encryption.
  • Familiarity with Docker and GitHub CI/CD

Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Experience with geo-spatial data (H3, PostGIS, GeoPandas).
  • Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines or analytics rule engines (Drools).
  • Understanding of streaming analytics and lakehouse architectures.
  • Knowledge of BI tools: QuickSight, Metabase, Power BI.

Soft Skills
  • Strong ownership and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication with cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable in a high-growth, fast-paced startup environment.

Why Join ServCrust?
  • Work on real-world logistics, finance, and IoT data impacting thousands of businesses.
  • Be part of a scalable, AI-driven SaaS ecosystem transforming the construction supply chain.
  • Growth opportunities into Data Platform Lead roles.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Kardiologian- ja keuhkosairauksien osasto
description:
Hei sairaanhoitaja! Kiinnostaisiko sinua monipuolinen ja vaihteleva työ sydän- ja keuhkopotilaiden parissa?

Mikäli vastauksesi on kyllä, Jorvin sairaalan Kardiologian ja keuhkosairauksien osasto 4A-B on sinulle sopiva työpaikka. Lue lisää alta ja hae paikkaa jo tänään!

Haemme sairaanhoitajaa vakinaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.1.2027 alkaen Sydän- ja keuhkokeskukseen, Jorvin sairaalaan Kardiologian ja keuhkosairauksien osasto 4A-Blle.


Työ osastollamme

Osastolla keskitytään erikoissairaanhoitoa vaativien sydän- ja keuhkopotilaiden hoitoon. Potilaspaikkoja on yhteensä 40. Osaston toiminnan luonne on päivystyksellinen ja työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa. Pääasialliset hoitoon tulon syyt ovat äkillinen sepelvaltimotauti, pahentunut sydämen vajaatoiminta, erilaiset rytmihäiriöt, COPD, keuhkokuume, pneumothorax ja keuhkosyöpä. Keuhkosairauksien osalta hoidetaan myös alueen tuberkuloosipotilaat. Sydänpotilaiden hoidon seurannassa käytetään telemetriaseurantaa.

Meillä sairaanhoitajan työssä korostuu hoitotyön kliininen asiantuntemus, potilaiden ja opiskelijoiden ohjaaminen sekä hoitotyön kehittäminen magneettisairaalamallin mukaisesti. Hoitotyön laatu, näyttöön perustuva toiminta, arvostava kohtaaminen sekä kollegiaalisuus ovat keskeisiä toimintaamme ohjaavia arvoja. Meillä työntekijät ovat tyytyväisiä moniammatilliseen yhteistyöhön, hoitotyön resursseihin ja ammatillisen kasvun mahdollisuuksiin.


Arvostamme

  • Kykyä kohdata äkillisesti sairaita potilaita ja heidän läheisiään
  • Hyviä yhteistyötaitoja: hyvä hoito syntyy potilaan ja moniammatillisen yhteistyön tuloksena
  • Kiinnostusta jatkuvaan kehittämiseen: parannamme jatkuvasti myös sitä, missä olemme jo hyviä
  • Kokemusta sairaalamaailmasta


Tarjoamme

Perehdytyksesi tukena ovat opetushoitaja, kollegat, apulaisosastonhoitaja ja osastonhoitaja. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus jatkuvaan ammatilliseen kasvuun ja urakehitykseen. Koulutustarjontamme on monipuolinen. Pyrimme kaikessa toiminnassamme huomiomaan työntekijöidemme yksilölliset elämäntilanteet ja tuemme joustavasti työ- ja yksityiselämän yhteensovittamista.

HUSin tarjoamat työsuhde-edut ovat käytettävissäsi. Näihin kuuluu mm. vuosittain jaettava kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja työsuhdematkalippuetu ePassin muodossa sekä liikunta- ja hyvinvointiyritysten henkilökunta-alennuksia. Jorvin sairaalassa on edullinen pysäköinti (16 €/kk).

Sairaanhoitajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3218,18 €/kk sekä mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.


Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa – hakemuksen lähettäminen on helppoa!

Haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää – panosta hyvään hakemukseen ja CV:hen, ja kerro osaamisestasi laajasti. Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 30.11.2026 mennessä!

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.



Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

title: Energy Systems Modeling Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a well-qualified Postdoctoral Research Associate in Engineering or comparable discipline for the Integrated Systems and Thermal Analysis Department. This postdoctoral researcher will focus on developing research software tools that hasten the deployment of domestic nuclear capacity. Our team works a 9x80 schedule located out of INL Research Center Idaho Falls facility with every other Friday off.


The Postdoctoral Research Associate will join a cross-functional team of engineers, economists, and software developers creating Python-based research software tools that help decision makers evaluate the economic feasibility of nuclear energy systems. Reporting to the Principal Investigator, this on-site role combines techno-economic modeling, optimization, and AI-assisted software development, including building and maintaining the cost data that underpins these analyses. The successful candidate will work closely with teammates across disciplines, contributing through shared code repositories, regular design discussions, and research that turns complex nuclear industry data into practical decision-making tools.

The candidate is expected to be a strong asset to our interdisciplinary R&D team and work effectively both alone and as a team member. The candidate must be self-motivated but also take direction from other team members and peers.

The position entails writing scientific manuscripts for journal publication, and presentation of research results at national and international conferences and meetings.

Required:

  • PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • PhD requirements must be completed by commencement of appointment and within the previous 5 years.
  • Demonstrated experience in techno-economic analysis, including building cost models and evaluating the financial viability of energy or infrastructure projects.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, modeling, and application development (pandas, NumPy, SciPy).
  • Working knowledge of financial analysis concepts such as discounted cash flow (DCF), net present value (NPV), internal rate of return (IRR), levelized cost of electricity (LCOE), weighted average cost of capital (WACC), depreciation, and escalation.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools and agentic workflows (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to build and maintain production code.
  • Demonstrated oral and published written communication skills in English with the ability to document methodologies, assumptions, and results clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Familiarity with the current nuclear energy landscape, including power uprate types (measurement uncertainty recapture, stretch, and extended power uprates) and the NRC licensing process.
  • Familiarity with relevant federal tax credits and incentives (e.g., 45U, 45Y, 48E) and how they factor into project financing.
  • Experience with optimization modeling in Pyomo, including formulating and solving linear, mixed-integer, and nonlinear problems.
  • Experience with probability and statistical time-series modeling such as ARMA, and including machine learning methods such as LSTM, Reinforcement Learning, etc.
  • Experience with capacity expansion modeling and/or dispatch optimization for electric power systems.
  • Experience with endogenous price formation models or electricity market modeling.
  • Familiarity with established energy system modeling tools (e.g., HERON, PyPSA, GenX, ReEDS, ALEAF, Temoa, or PLEXOS).
  • Experience in power systems, protection engineering, state estimation, or synchrophasor data.
  • Familiarity with network security monitoring, intrusion detection, or industrial control system protocols.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, use hands to handle materials, manipulate tools, keyboard and type, reach with hands and arms, and operate job-related equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with people is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Information:

  • The pay for this position is $105,144.00 Annually. At Idaho National Laboratory compensation decisions are determined using factors such as education, relevant experience, and other credentials.

Our mission is simple: Take Care of People. Guided by our core values of Integrity, Teamwork, Innovation, Education, Quality Outcomes, and Fiscal Responsibility, we are building a quality post-acute healthcare system that supports patients, families, and communities.

We provide a full continuum of services—including Skilled Nursing, Rehabilitation, Memory Care, Pulmonary Care, Assisted Living, and Independent Living—with a focus on exceptional outcomes and quality of life.   • Early wage Access
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • HMGU Scholarship Program
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan

Join us and be part of a team where Taking Care of People is more than our mission—it’s our culture!

***Shifts Available: Split Shift or Double Weekends***

About the Role:

The Certified Medication Aide (CMA) at Stallings Court Nursing & Rehabilitation plays a critical role in supporting the healthcare team by safely administering medications to residents in accordance with established protocols and regulatory standards. This position ensures that each resident receives the correct medication at the prescribed times, contributing directly to their health, comfort, and overall well-being. The CMA collaborates closely with nurses and other healthcare professionals to monitor residents for any adverse reactions or changes in condition, promptly reporting concerns to ensure timely interventions. Additionally, the role involves maintaining accurate medication records and adhering to strict confidentiality and safety guidelines. Ultimately, the CMA helps to enhance the quality of care provided within the facility, fostering a safe and supportive environment for all residents.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Current and valid Certified Medication Aide (CMA) certification as required by state regulations.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic knowledge of medication administration principles and safety standards.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain accurate records.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience working in a long-term care or rehabilitation facility.
  • Additional certifications related to healthcare or medication administration.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and experience working with elderly or disabled populations.
  • CPR and First Aid certification.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer prescribed medications to residents accurately and timely, following the five rights of medication administration.
  • Monitor residents for side effects or adverse reactions and report any concerns to nursing staff immediately.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate medication records, including documentation of administration and any observed changes in resident condition.
  • Assist nursing staff with routine care tasks as needed, supporting overall resident health and comfort.
  • Ensure compliance with all facility policies, state regulations, and safety protocols related to medication handling and administration.
  • Communicate effectively with residents to explain medication procedures and provide reassurance.

title: Project Coordination Specialist (SPEED), Jakarta, Indonesia, P3
description:
The Position:

The Project Coordination Specialist plays a key role in improving programme coordination, partnership and advocacy, and in ensuring the sound management of financial resources. You will focus on providing managerial, technical, and operational coordination for a successful and accountable implementation of the SPEED Indonesia project (Strengthening Professional Education and Enhanced Policy Framework for Midwifery Development in Indonesia, 2026-2030). The project is jointly implemented by UNFPA Indonesia and the Indonesian Ministry of Health with funding support from the Korean International Cooperation Agency (KOICA).

You will report to the Assistant Representative and works in close coordination with the SRH Programme Specialist under the overall guidance of the UNFPA Representative.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results

Job Purpose:

Working within the UNFPA Indonesia Country Office, the Project Coordination Specialist will lead the coordination and effective implementation of the SPEED Indonesia Project, a partnership between UNFPA, the Ministry of Health (MoH) of the Republic of Indonesia, and KOICA.

The Specialist will ensure that project activities are well-coordinated, timely, within budget, and compliant with KOICA requirements and UNFPA policies and procedures. The position will serve as a key interface with KOICA, MoH and other partners, ensuring effective communication, accountability, monitoring and reporting.

The Specialist will coordinate delivery of the project’s two key results: strengthening the capacity of 12 MoH Health Polytechnics and improving the national Continuing Professional Development (CPD) system for midwives, contributing to improved quality of midwifery education and services and ultimately to reduced maternal and neonatal mortality in Indonesia.

You would be responsible for:

A. Project Management

  • Providing managerial, technical and operational coordination and oversight for the SPEED Indonesia project, ensuring timely, high-quality and cost-effective delivery of results in line with the approved logical framework, UNFPA policies and procedures, and KOICA requirements;
  • Ensuring effective management and use of project resources, including providing guidance on administrative, operational and financial matters and supporting the Head of Programme and UNFPA management in the oversight of project financial resources;
  • Provide substantive guidance and technical support to implementing partners and relevant stakeholders, and coordinate with the Ministry of Health and other national counterparts to ensure effective project implementation, in alignment with national health priorities and achievement of agreed project results. ;
  • Oversee project procurement planning and monitor the timely procurement, delivery, installation and operationalization of specialized equipment for the 12 Ministry of Health Health Polytechnics, in close coordination with relevant technical, procurement and operations teams, ensuring compliance with UNFPA procurement policies and KOICA requirements. ;
  • Manage the partnership and maintain regular substantive engagement with the KOICA Indonesia Country Office, ensuring effective communication, coordination and follow-up on project implementation, donor requirements and agreed commitments. Coordinate joint monitoring missions, project review meetings, visibility activities and other donor engagement initiatives.
  • Leading the timely preparation and quality assurance of annual work plans, substantive and financial reports, briefs and other required project documentation, in accordance with UNFPA and KOICA reporting requirements;
  • Providing strategic analysis and advice to UNFPA management and the Project Steering Committee on project performance, risks, challenges, lessons learned and required corrective actions.


    B. Project Monitoring
  • Overseeing the establishment and implementation of effective monitoring and evaluation mechanisms to track project progress, results and performance indicators;
  • Ensuring the timely collection, analysis and validation of evidence against key project indicators, including implementation of the revised ICM curriculum, use of clinical logbooks and enrolment of midwives in CPD subjects;
  • Managing the timely production, review and submission of progress reports by project partners, ensuring the quality, consistency and reliability of reported results;
  • Identifying areas requiring adjustment or improvement and facilitating timely corrective action and adaptive management based on monitoring findings and lessons learned;
  • Ensure effective implementation of UNFPA's accountability and monitoring requirements throughout project implementation, including appropriate oversight of implementing partners and follow-up on identified compliance and performance issues. ;
  • Lead and coordinate project reviews and evaluations and ensuring that findings, recommendations and lessons learned are documented and incorporated into future planning and implementation.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:

  • An advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in Public Health, Midwifery, Health Systems Management, International Development, Social Sciences, or a related field is required.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • A minimum of 5 years of professional experience in development work, especially programme/project management;
  • Solid knowledge and practical experience in sexual and reproductive health, youth and gender issues are required;
  • Demonstrated experience in establishing and managing partnerships and working relationships with government institutions, academic institutions, development partners and other relevant stakeholders is required;
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, negotiation and coordination skills, with demonstrated ability to engage effectively with senior government counterparts, development partners and other stakeholders is required.
  • Excellent report writing and compelling oral presentations are required;
  • Familiarity with the UN system is desirable.

Languages:

  • Fluency in English is required. Working knowledge of Korean would be an asset.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity,
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
  • Embracing cultural diversity,
  • Embracing change

Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results,
  • Being accountable,
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,
  • Thinking analytically and strategically,
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,
  • Communicating for impact

Functional Competencies:

  • Advocacy/ Advancing a policy-oriented agenda
  • Leveraging the resources of national governments and partners/ building strategic alliances and partnerships
  • Delivering results-based programme
  • Internal and external communication and advocacy for results mobilization

Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply.   • High level of expertise in written, oral, and interpersonal communication.

  • Demonstrated skill in effective use and management of automated medical management systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to function independently and cooperatively.

  • Understanding of healthcare and/or HMO industry.

  • Demonstrated experience in hiring, orientation, coaching, and team building of professional staff.

  • Demonstrated flexibility and organization.

  • Demonstrated appropriate decision making under challenging situations.

CHALLENGES:

DECISION-MAKING:

title: Polysomnographic Technologist Lead
description:
Polysomnographic Technologist Lead

Regions Hospital is looking to hire a Polysomnographic Technologist Lead to join our team! Come join us as a Partner for Good and help us make an impact on the care and experience that our patients and their families receive every day.

Position Summary:

The Lead Polysomnographic Technologist works under medical supervision to perform and evaluate overnight polysomnograms. This individual functions independently to safely operate sophisticated medical equipment to record sleep/wake physiology. The application of recording devices, cleaning/sterilization of equipment, and monitoring of polysomnogram are essential duties of the technologist. Polysomnographic technologists must recognize sleep pathology when it occurs in the laboratory and respond with the appropriate interventions to ensure patient safety.

Knowledge of normal cardiorespiratory, neurologic, and sleep physiology is essential to the polysomnographic technologist. The technologist understands the function of equipment used to monitor and record breathing (airflow/effort), electroencephalograms (brain waves), electrocardiograms (heart rate and rhythm), electromyograms (muscle activity), and pulse oximetry (blood oxygenation/saturation).

The polysomnographic technologist monitors nasal continuous positive pressure, oxygen, and employs ventilatory assist devices in accordance with established protocols. This individual is also Certified in Basic Life Support. The technologist also performs special procedures such as multiple sleep latency testing, pediatric polysomnography, ambulatory monitoring, and patient education.

Record review/scoring of polysomnograms is an integral part of the job and may consume as much time as data acquisition. The identification of normal/abnormal patterns, artifacts, and sleep/wake stages is critical to high quality patient care. The polysomnographic technologist generates a report that accurately and concisely summarizes the patient’s sleep/wake stages, respiratory events, cardiac event, limb movements, arousal analysis, and other clinical events.

Work Schedule:

Monday - Friday 7:00am to 3:30pm

Required Qualifications:

  • Education, Experience or Equivalent Combination:
    • Associate degree with emphasis in polysomnography or completion of the A-STEP program (Accredited Sleep Technologist Education Program) by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) and the American Association of Sleep Technologists (AAST).
    • Three to five years of scoring experience
    • Completion of a BS/BA in a medical/science related field may be considered along with three to five years of scoring experience
  • Licensure/ Registration/ Certification:
    • Certification by the Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists as a Registered Polysomnographic Technologist.
    • Certified in Basic Cardiac Life Support

title: UI/UX Lead
description:
Critical Manufacturing is dedicated to empowering high-performance operations to make Industry 4.0 a reality with the most innovative, comprehensive, and modular MES software. We have a global presence, but our headquarters, and the main technical center, are in Porto (Maia), Portugal, where we develop a state-of-the-art solution for Semiconductor, Electronics, Life Sciences, and Industrial Equipment.

Recognized as a Leader by Gartner, we are part of ASMPT, the world's largest supplier of best-in-class equipment, and technological process partner for the electronics and semiconductor industries.


The Role

Critical Manufacturing is seeking an experienced UI/UX Lead to drive user experience strategy and lead our design team in building next-generation Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and industrial automation software. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team of UI/UX designers and researchers while shaping intuitive, error-resilient, and high-efficiency interfaces for shop floor operators, plant managers, quality engineers, and process engineers.

You will bridge the gap between complex industrial workflows (such as ISA-88/ISA-95 standards, Master Batch Records, batch execution, and traceability) and modern, human-centered design. You will balance team management, strategic UI/UX vision, and hands-on design leadership to transform complex operational data into seamless, mission-critical software solutions.


What You Will Do

  • Lead & Mentor: Manage, coach, and support a dedicated team of UI/UX designers and researchers; strengthen team cohesion, set clear expectations, improve delivery, conduct regular 1-on-1s, drive skill development, and set clear performance benchmarks.
  • Resource & Capacity Management: Manage project allocation across core MES product modules, evaluate design staffing needs, and lead hiring and onboarding for new UI/UX talent.
  • Establish user experience frameworks tailored to shop floor conditions, operator efficiency, rapid data entry, alarm management, and context-aware operational dashboards.
  • Scale and maintain an industrial-grade Design System optimized for high-density data, tactile/touchscreen interactions, shop floor lighting environments, and accessible UI patterns.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Manufacturing Engineers, Industrial Data Specialists to define feature roadmaps and system capabilities.
  • Conduct and guide contextual research (including plant floor observational studies and operator interviews) to translate operational constraints into actionable design requirements.
  • Ensure UI/UX workflows support industry regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ISO standards, and ISA-88/95 models) including audit trails, electronic signatures, and batch record accuracy.


What you must have:

  • 5+ years of professional UI/UX Product Design experience, with a proven track record in enterprise software, industrial automation, MES, SCADA, ERP, or complex B2B SaaS platforms.
  • 2+ years of formal experience managing and leading design teams.
  • Demonstrates expertise in solving complex visual and functional information architectures, high-density data visualization, workflow simplification, and team leadership.
  • Deep understanding of operator workflows, shop floor ergonomics, and high-density industrial dashboards.
  • Advanced mastery of Figma, prototyping tools, and scalable Design Systems, as well as the application of AI tools for UI/UX.
  • Proficiency in quantitative and qualitative research methodologies suitable for industrial or enterprise environments.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex technological and operational concepts clearly to engineering teams, executive stakeholders, and plant supervisors.
  • Passion for mentoring designers and translating raw industrial data into intuitive human experiences.
  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.


What we consider a plus (not mandatory):

  • UX/UI for Industrial Systems



Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are a source of commitment and innovation

At Critical Manufacturing, we welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of disabilities, diverse abilities, identities, or experiences. Our commitment is to create an inclusive environment where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and thrive.

If you need accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know - we're happy to support you.

title: Manager Streetlight Operations Strategy
description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,500 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of 3,780 megawatts.

About the Opportunity

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp. [SC00

Position Summary

The Manager, Streetlight Operations & Strategy serves as the accountable leader for FirstEnergy's end-to-end streetlight business, overseeing a portfolio of approximately 885,000 streetlight assets across five states. This role is responsible for portfolio performance, customer experience, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, data governance, modernization strategy, and realization of operational savings opportunities.

The position provides enterprise leadership for the development and execution of FirstEnergy's streetlight strategy and multi-year modernization roadmap, ensuring alignment across operating companies, functional organizations, and municipal stakeholders. The Manager leads a team of four Streetlight Specialists and two Strategy & Planning resources and serves as the single point of accountability for streetlight business performance, asset integrity, governance, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Portfolio Governance

  • Develop and execute the enterprise streetlight strategy and multi-year modernization roadmap.
  • Establish long-term plans for asset modernization, LED conversion, smart lighting technologies, customer-driven enhancements, and emerging service offerings.
  • Identify, prioritize, and drive enterprise improvement initiatives that enhance service, operational efficiency, and portfolio performance.
  • Benchmark streetlight operations against industry leaders and incorporate best practices through organizations such as EEI and other utility industry forums.
  • Provide enterprise governance over the streetlight business, ensuring alignment of strategy, operating practices, investments, and performance objectives across all operating companies.

Business & Program Management

  • Serve as the enterprise owner of the streetlight business, accountable for portfolio performance, customer experience, asset integrity, operational execution, and financial results.
  • Monitor and report portfolio performance, service levels, operational metrics, financial performance, and strategic initiatives.
  • Own the identification, realization, and sustainment of operational savings opportunities and efficiency improvements across the streetlight lifecycle.
  • Lead execution of major initiatives, including data reconciliation, workflow automation, customer self-service capabilities, asset modernization programs, and process transformation efforts.
  • Establish performance metrics, governance structures, and accountability mechanisms to ensure delivery of business objectives.

Customer & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Serve as FirstEnergy's primary representative for streetlight-related matters with municipalities, regulatory agencies, community stakeholders, and industry organizations.
  • Oversee customer agreements, service commitments, contract administration, and escalation management.
  • Drive improvements in customer communications, outage management, service transparency, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Build and maintain effective matrix relationships with State Presidents, Operations, Customer Experience, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, IT, and other functional leaders.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure adherence to end-to-end streetlight processes, controls, and operating standards.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve productivity, reduce unnecessary field dispatches, enhance work order execution, and improve service responsiveness.
  • Establish and monitor service-level agreements, operational performance standards, and key performance indicators.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, standardization, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.

Data Governance & Asset Management

  • Establish enterprise ownership of streetlight data governance and asset records.
  • Ensure accurate, reconciled, and decision-ready asset information across GIS, SAP, and associated operational systems.
  • Develop and maintain governance standards that support accurate billing, regulatory compliance, operational planning, and investment decisions.
  • Oversee portfolio reporting, business analytics, performance dashboards, and management insights.

Regulatory & Financial Stewardship

  • Coordinate with Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Rates, and Finance organizations on streetlight-related matters.
  • Support tariff modernization, new service offerings, and evolving customer programs.
  • Monitor business performance and identify opportunities for revenue protection, operational efficiencies, and cost optimization.
  • Be accountable for portfolio financial performance, including operating budgets, capital investment planning, business case development, vendor contracts, and benefit realization.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Streetlight Specialists and Strategy & Planning professionals.
  • Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business objectives.
  • Foster a culture of customer focus, collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop organizational capabilities necessary to support portfolio growth, modernization, and future business needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Utility Management, Finance, or a related field.
  • Seven or more years of leadership experience in utility operations, asset management, program management, customer operations, or related infrastructure-intensive environments.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide initiatives requiring cross-functional alignment and influence across multiple organizations.
  • Proven experience driving operational excellence, process improvement, and business performance results.
  • Strong analytical, financial, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing complex stakeholder relationships and operating within matrixed organizations.

Benefits, Compensation & Workforce Diversity

At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Safety

Safety is a core value for FirstEnergy and is essential to all of our business activities. Our goals are to provide a safe work environment, to maintain an accident-free, injury-free workplace, and to promote and maintain public safety. title: Receiving and Loading Specialist
description:
Job Title: Receiving and Loading Specialist

Pay Range: PG 2

Location: Onalaska
EEOC Number and Classification: #8810, Operatives

Reports to: Purchasing and Inventory Control Supervisor

Job Function/NAICS: 339950

Status: Non-Exempt

Date: May 10, 2024

Description:

A Receiving and Loading Specialist at La Crosse Sign Group is responsible for efficiently handling incoming raw and project materials and loading outgoing signs and installation components. This individual ensures the accuracy of incoming shipments and outbound deliveries, while maintaining organized internal and external storage areas. This role is crucial in supporting the smooth operations of our fabrication area and crew installations by verifying and ensuring the accuracy of incoming and outgoing materials, while adhering to safety and quality standards.


What You’ll Do:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This list of essential functions is not exhaustive and may be supplemented as necessary.

  • Receiving:
  • Inspect and verify incoming shipments, including signage for installation, against purchase orders and packing lists.
  • Unloads goods from trucks, containers and other transport vehicles using appropriate equipment within safety guidelines.
  • Inspects and checks all incoming materials for damage and reports discrepancies or issues to the Shipper and Purchasing and Inventory Control Supervisor.
  • Processes accurate documentation and record-keeping of received goods.
  • Reports incoming shipments to Installation/Operational Team Leaders per operating procedures.


  • Loading:
  • Prepare and load products/signage onto trucks, trailers, and other transport vehicles for delivery or installation.
  • Responsible for wrapping, loading and securing materials in a safe and efficient manner to ensure signs and associated components arrive safely and undamaged.
  • Will assist Installation and Service crews with loading materials for the day, and ensuring all components of the various installation jobs are at the truck shop and ready to go for delivery/install each morning.
  • Works closely with Install Crew Leaders to coordinate loads and schedules.


  • Inventory Management:
  • Assists in maintaining accurate inventory records.
  • Conducts regular stock counts and reports/corrects discrepancies.
  • Stores products, signage and various components in designated locations, and maintains the cleanliness and organization of those areas.


What You Need:

  • Experience loading and receiving materials, preferably handling components of varying heights and weights onto and off trucks and open trailers.
  • Previous experience in a warehouse or logistics role.
  • Proficiency in operating forklifts and other powered industrial vehicles.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to lift and move large and sometimes heavy objects.
  • Basic computer skills for inventory and documentation purposes
  • Time management skills to ensure tasks are completed on schedule while still maintaining quality standards.
  • Collaboration and teamwork skills.
  • Willingness to educate and support peers and team members.
  • Commitment to quality and safety standards.

Who We Are:

For over 100 years, La Crosse Sign Group has worked diligently to develop an organization dedicated to the service of our clients. From our humble beginnings in 1917, we have adapted to an ever-expanding and diverse industry. Our evolution into what we are today happened because of company leaders, hiring the best people in the industry, and empowering them to act decisively. We now have three locations in Wisconsin: La Crosse, Madison, and Eau Claire. Through everything we do, we will continue to reach higher and not only meet, but also exceed the expectations of our clients with our proven process of consultation, creation, and conclusion.

Our mission is to help companies make an extraordinary first impression. We all know how important a first impression can be, it can make or break someone's decision to be your friend, buy your product, or to even enter your business in the first place. At La Crosse Sign Group our purpose is to help businesses make a statement that will "wow" customers and leave a lasting positive impact. This purpose, paired with our expertise in custom fabrication and design, fuel our cause of helping our communities and local businesses succeed.

La Crosse Sign operates under EOS, the Entrepreneurial Operating System, where we value input and ideas from all employees and live by the following Core Values:

  • Leading with a commitment to excellence
  • Supportive of one another win or lose
  • Grateful every day
  • Mindful of our actions
  • Adaptable to change
  • Always putting safety first

Working Conditions:

Operates in a demanding, fast-paced, people-oriented production environment with routine exposure to dirt, noise, temperature variance, chemicals, and solvents. Works primarily on concrete surfaces, occasionally on ladders and operates powered industrial vehicles. Deadline pressure is an integral part of the job with the potential for managing multiple project assignments. Works with a variety of people including vendors, customers, employees, and leadership.

Required Work Schedule:

Work hours are generally during normal operational hours 6:00am to 4:00pm Monday-Thursday with variable hours on Fridays, and an average of at least 40 hours a week. There may be small variations in work hours due to special projects, training new and existing staff, and meeting customer deadlines.

Physical Requirements:

Will alternate walking, sitting, and standing throughout work shift. Ability to work in a variety of positions including, but not limited to kneeling, crouching, bending, twisting, turning, and climbing. Must be able to climb and stand on a ladder for periods of time. Ability to lift and carry 50 pounds at times during the shift. There is regular use of the keyboard and telephone. Requires the ability to receive detailed information through verbal communication. Vision acuity corrected to 20/40.

What We Offer

  • Two weeks of Paid Time Off and additional Paid Personal Time
  • Paid holidays
  • 401k, with up to a 4% company match
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Company provided Life Insurance
  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Opportunity for Annual Profit Sharing
  • Exceptional Employee Assistance Program
  • Year-round work schedule
  • And so much more...

title: Medical Research Data Scientist
description:
The Medical Research Data Scientist will work in the Department of Neurology under the direction of the Principal Investigator and in collaboration with faculty investigators, biostatisticians, research staff, trainees, and data analysts. The position will support epidemiologic studies of Parkinson’s disease and related neurological disorders, applying data science and statistical methods to investigate disease risk, progression, treatment effectiveness, and patient outcomes.

The Medical Research Data Scientist will apply advanced data science, statistical, and computational methods to complex research projects. The successful candidate will work with large and diverse data sources, including electronic health records, administrative data, and longitudinal research data. This may include developing and implementing data collection approaches using wearable devices to track environmental exposures, geolocation, and continuous biometric measures, such as electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings. They will develop reproducible approaches to cleaning, linking, managing, and analyzing these data and will work independently to address complex analytical and computational challenges.

The Medical Research Data Scientist will also serve as a technical resource for multidisciplinary research teams, helping investigators identify appropriate statistical and computational approaches and develop tools and workflows for complex analyses. They may provide technical guidance to other research staff and analysts.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with faculty investigators, biostatisticians, research staff, trainees, and data analysts to achieve study objectives.

  • Builds automated systems to produce up-to-date reports on key statistics and participation of ongoing studies.

  • Develop multivariable analysis plans in consultation with investigators and biostatisticians and independently conduct analyses using appropriate statistical methods.

  • Analyze large collections of electronic health record (EHR) notes, including datasets with millions of records, using natural language processing (NLP) methods and large language models (LLMs) in R and Python through UCSF-approved, PHI-safe API infrastructure.

  • Conduct computationally intensive data processing and analysis using high-performance computing resources, including Linux computing clusters and other distributed computing environments.

  • Develop dynamic reports, data visualizations, and other tools to communicate study progress and research findings to investigators, collaborators, sponsors, and broader audiences.

  • Link records across multiple administrative and research datasets using deterministic and probabilistic matching methods.

  • Write clear, reproducible, well-documented code using Git for version control, with code quality and documentation suitable for sharing in public repositories.

  • Develop clear documentation of data management and analytical methods and contribute statistical and technical sections to grant proposals, manuscripts, presentations, and reports.

  • Contribute to study design and help ensure that appropriate, high-quality data are collected to address study hypotheses and research objectives.

  • Collaborate with investigators on scientific manuscripts and other research products.

The mission of the Department of Neurology at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) includes delivering the most exceptional clinical care to our patients, leading transformative cutting-edge research, and training the leaders of tomorrow in both neurology and neuroscience. Our department’s faculty, trainees, and staff work at a University and in a community that values and embraces diversity and strives to make an impact worldwide through our global and public health efforts.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:

BAND LEVEL: Mid–Senior / L4–L5
📍 Hybrid (Hyderabad, India) · 3 Days On-Site | Shift: 14:00 – 23:00 IST | Immediate Onboarding

Your mission? Move past brittle prompt chaining and single-turn completions to architect production-ready, autonomous multi-agent runtimes. You will engineer resilient cyclic execution graphs, wire deterministic tool-calling layers via MCP, and build self-correcting reasoning loops that execute complex workflows during peak overlapping operational hours.

→ Python (AsyncIO) / Pydantic
→ LangGraph / AutoGen / CrewAI
→ Model Context Protocol (MCP) / Function Calling
→ Qdrant / pgvector / Hybrid Search
→ FastAPI / Docker / Temporal
→ LangSmith / Arize Phoenix (Tracing & Evals)

01 // Deterministic Control Planes — Probabilistic LLM outputs must be constrained by strict JSON schemas, typed validation, and deterministic graph state transitions.

02 // Autonomous Self-Correction — Agents must inspect tool execution payloads, diagnose runtime failures, and self-heal dynamically before hitting human escalation fallbacks.

03 // Relentless Observability — Every token budget, decision branch, and tool latency spike is traced; unmonitored agent loops do not reach production.
If you treat agent loops like predictable distributed systems rather than weekend demo experiments, this bench is built for you

title: Product Designer
description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.


About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.


Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:


Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.


About the role

As a key designer on the nesto Servicing team, you will drive the end-to-end design process from discovery to delivery, partnering with cross-functional teams to shape our product vision. You will act as a relentless advocate for the user, leveraging direct customer feedback and data to transform complex problems into simple, intuitive experiences. By actively integrating AI-powered tools into your daily workflow, you will accelerate ideation and prototyping while owning and evolving our scalable design system to deliver beautiful, highly functional solutions.


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the design process for key products and features, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to define the product vision and align on strategy.
  • Own and evolve our design system so that it can scale across multiple platforms and teams.
  • Translate user research, analytics, and feedback into beautiful, functional designs that solve real problems.
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools in your day-to-day work to accelerate research, ideation, design exploration, prototyping, and iteration.
  • Use AI to move from ideas to tangible experiences faster, exploring multiple design directions, generating interactive prototypes, and validating concepts before committing to development.
  • Create high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and animations that impress stakeholders and users alike.
  • Facilitate design workshops and brainstorming sessions to inspire creativity across teams.
  • Advocate for the user at every stage, ensuring design decisions are grounded in user needs and usability.
  • Be opinionated and leverage a direct line to our customers to get insights. Explore solutions, create prototypes, and dive into user feedback and data to identify friction and opportunities for improvement.
  • Stay current with emerging design technologies, AI capabilities, tools, and industry best practices, bringing new approaches to how we design and deliver products.
  • Sweat the details, prioritize simplicity, and seamlessly integrate interconnected projects to transform complex tasks into intuitive experiences.


Who we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products (web, mobile, or SaaS).
  • A strong portfolio showcasing UX/UI case studies, high-impact product design, and innovative solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma or similar design tools, with an interest in code, motion design, or interactive prototyping.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools as part of your regular design workflow, whether for research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, design exploration, or improving productivity.
  • Comfortable experimenting with emerging AI design and development tools, such as Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable, v0, or similar platforms, to accelerate how ideas are explored and brought to life.
  • Ability to combine strong design fundamentals with AI-assisted workflows, knowing when to leverage automation and when human judgment, creativity, and attention to detail matter most.
  • Experience setting up user research sessions and using tools such as Maze, UserTesting, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working within agile teams and collaborating with developers, PMs, and other stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to balance business goals with user needs to create designs that are both functional and beautiful.
  • Strong understanding of design systems and component libraries, with a focus on efficiency, consistency, and the end-user experience.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present your work and confidently guide discussions with senior leadership.

A curious, problem-solving mindset, with a passion for experimenting, challenging established approaches, and iterating quickly.


Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.

  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.
