title: AI Measurement Scientist, AI Evaluation Platform
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger.

Our team, part of Apple Services Engineering, is building the scientific foundation for how AI systems are evaluated across Apple. Our goal is to create the evidence that teams can act on: what to measure, whether a change helped, why a system failed, and whether it is ready to ship. We are seeking a Measurement Scientist to ensure that our evaluation methods are not just sophisticated, but scientifically valid and trustworthy. In this role, you will apply apply state-of-the-art measurement methods, validity frameworks, experimental design, and statistical rigor to establish measurement standards for AI evaluation, ensuring that when we claim an evaluator measures "helpfulness" or "safety," it actually does. We are looking for individuals across a range of experience levels.

This role uniquely bridges measurement science and cutting-edge AI evaluation. This role uniquely bridges measurement science and cutting-edge AI evaluation. Our team is building AI tools and capabilities to help developers do evaluation better and faster. You will develop methods for validating these tools: making sure that they generate evaluation artifacts and workflows that give developers the right signals to make sound engineering decisions and build great products for Apple customers.

You will work on an interdisciplinary team with with other measurement scientists and ML researchers to solve new problems in AI evaluation. Your work will be both published at top measurement and ML venues and productionized into the evaluation SDK used across Apple. The successful candidate will have deep expertise in psychometrics or other measurement disciplines, or in experimental design and causal inference, with the ability to apply these principles to novel AI evaluation challenges. Our team deliberately combines ML science and measurement science. We especially welcome people who bridge those areas, including computer scientists who specialize in measurement, and measurement scientists who have worked on ML problems. You will also work collaboratively with platform engineers and evaluation practitioners to translate measurement science into practical tools that scale across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • PhD in Computer Science or Machine Learning with a measurement or evaluation focus, Psychometrics, Educational Measurement, Quantitative Psychology, Statistics, Biostatistics, Econometrics, or equivalent research/work experience.
  • Deep expertise in modeling test or benchmark data (IRT, latent variable, or other response models) and construct validation, in benchmark design and validity for AI systems, or in experimental design and causal inference (surrogate outcomes, observational causal methods).
  • Strong statistical foundation including experimental design, power analysis, sampling theory, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Track record of designing and validating measurement instruments or experiments as demonstrated through publications or applied work.
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred) or R for statistical analysis, psychometric modeling, and method implementation.
  • Strong working knowledge of generative AI technology.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts to engineers, ML researchers, and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Research or experience applying measurement science to AI/ML evaluation, benchmark validity, automated scoring systems, or computational assessment.
  • Knowledge of modern ML evaluation challenges including LLM-as-judge, automated metrics, benchmark design, and agentic systems.
  • Publications at measurement venues or top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).
  • Expertise in computational social or behavioral science using generative AI.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers to turn research methods into production tools and scalable infrastructure.
  • Experience with online experimentation or with validating offline metrics against real-world outcomes (surrogate or proxy metrics).
  • Experience estimating rare events or making decisions when one kind of error costs far more than another.

title: IP Enforcement Senior Investigator
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

As part of Apple's IP Enforcement team, you'll uphold Apple's high ethical, legal and corporate standards and defend our valuable intellectual property.

Working for a company that invents best-in-class technology products means you'll creatively apply your deep investigative expertise to unique challenges that often involve complex aspects of criminal and civil law.

We're looking for a seasoned IP crime and fraud investigator to be part of a small, dynamic and high tempo IP enforcement team covering the highly diverse Europe, Middle East, India, Africa (EMEIA) Region. You will help direct a high volume of investigative cases, many of which are complex and challenging with urgent deadlines. You'll be a subject matter expert in intelligence and evidence collection and presentation, working at the intersection of IP, criminal and civil law.

You must have outstanding initiative, judgment, and written and verbal communication skills.

Apple's IP Enforcement team combats the global production, distribution, and sale of counterfeit Apple products and pirated original content. As a Senior Investigator in Apple's EMEIA IP Enforcement team, you'll carry out investigations and deliver on the execution of enforcement strategy at the interface of IP criminal, civil and regulatory law.

You'll serve as an advisor to internal Apple colleagues, supporting on complex, high-stakes IP infringement cases, including criminal prosecutions and civil lawsuits.

You'll develop creative, pragmatic approaches to complex and urgent enforcement issues, sometimes in new markets where established precedent does not always exist, while maintaining an acceptable level of legal risk.

The position requires a broad and deep investigative skill set, a high degree of self-sufficiency, independent judgment, and a results-oriented approach.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree.
  • 8+ years of investigative experience, with primary focus on IP crime and fraud investigations.
  • Skilled at data analysis and intelligence processing.
  • Experience in managing investigations into counterfeit manufacture distribution and sales operations.
  • Experience in managing fraud investigations.
  • Skilled at drafting complex and technical witness statements.
  • Trial experience as a court expert witness.
  • Deep familiarity with global organised crime networks and smuggling techniques.
  • Track record of conducting complex, multi-jurisdictional investigative matters with significant business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in-house at a technology company or at a top-tier firm representing technology clients.
  • Technical background or demonstrated ability to quickly grasp complex technical subject matter.
  • Experience with IP law (trademark, design, copyright) issues.
  • Experience working in partnership with enforcement and regulatory authorities.
  • Experience advising on legislative and regulatory policy initiatives and their consequences.
  • Experience with Covert Human Intelligence Source (CHIS) operations and CHIS intelligence exploitation.
  • Experience working in Africa and especially in high risk developing markets.
  • Experience using specialist analytical software (i2, iBase, Maltego), and Apple's iWork suite (Keynote, Numbers, Pages) and Microsoft Office.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to embrace emerging technologies and innovation, leveraging AI to improve efficiency and streamline workflows, and to enhance investigative techniques.
  • Experience using forensic examination equipment and product identification techniques (x-ray, digital and multi-wavelength microscopy).
  • Ability to travel within EMEIA Region, sometimes at short notice, to support urgent law enforcement operations.

title: Accounts Manager

Bonus Potential: Additional quarterly performance-based bonuses

About the Role

First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is seeking three Account Managers to oversee client relationships, staffing coordination, and day-to-day operations for assigned security accounts throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex.

This position is focused on building strong client relationships, ensuring exceptional service delivery, supporting assigned personnel, and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts. Account Managers will serve as the primary point of contact for their assigned clients, proactively addressing concerns, anticipating operational needs, and ensuring both client satisfaction and employee success.

While each Account Manager will have direct responsibility for their individual accounts, they will also be part of a collaborative team that works together, shares resources, and supports one another to ensure the overall success of FRPS and its clients. Account Managers will report directly to the Director of Field Operations for DFW and will be expected to demonstrate strong ownership, teamwork, and a commitment to both operational excellence and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned security accounts, ensuring client satisfaction, quality service, and reliable staffing.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building strong relationships through regular communication and account visits.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to expand services, grow existing accounts, and strengthen client partnerships.
  • Coordinate employee schedules, address staffing shortages, and ensure all client coverage requirements are met.
  • Support assigned employees by providing guidance, addressing concerns, and promoting a positive, accountable work environment.
  • Work with Recruiting and HR to interview, hire, and maintain qualified personnel for assigned accounts.
  • Review and approve employee timesheets, ensuring accuracy and timely payroll processing.
  • Respond to client concerns, resolve service issues, and follow through to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with fellow Account Managers and leadership to share resources, solve challenges, and support overall team success.
  • Monitor account performance, maintain service standards, and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Participate in client retention efforts and work with Sales to pursue additional business opportunities.
  • Be available on-call as needed for escalated matters requiring management involvement or decision-making, with dedicated after-hours support staff handling routine issues and serving as the first point of contact.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in account management, customer service, operations, staffing, or supervisory roles preferred.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to build and maintain professional client relationships.
  • Ability to manage employee schedules, address staffing shortages, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Experience handling customer concerns, employee performance issues, and sensitive personnel matters professionally.
  • Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution abilities.
  • Ability to recognize business opportunities, support client retention, and contribute to account growth.
  • Bachelor's degree is a plus, but not required.
  • Strong candidates demonstrating initiative, accountability, and a willingness to take ownership will also be considered.

Job Requirements

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to and from FRPS Corporate Headquarters in Addison, TX.
  • Proficiency with computers, scheduling systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Conduct account visits and travel between assigned locations, and keep communication with assigned guards.
  • Availability to be on-call as needed for scheduling and staffing matters.
  • Demonstrate a strong work ethic, positive attitude, and self-motivated approach to overcoming challenges, taking ownership of responsibilities, and consistently striving for success.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a motivated, results-driven Account Manager who takes ownership of assigned accounts and is committed to building strong, lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and able to balance client expectations, employee needs, and company objectives while consistently following through on commitments.

We value individuals who enjoy working directly with customers, take initiative in resolving challenges, and are comfortable making decisions that support both operational success and business growth. This is an opportunity for someone who is driven to succeed, enjoys taking on new challenges, and wants to directly influence their professional and financial growth through client retention, account development, and overall performance.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Vatsaelinkirurgian osasto 3D-E Jorvin sairaala
description:
Tule mukaan osaavaan ja lämminhenkiseen tiimiimme hoitamaan vatsaelinkirurgisia päivystyspotilaita!

Haemme sairaanhoitajia vakinaisiin ja määräaikaisiin tehtäviin Jorvin sairaalan vatsaelinkirurgiselle osastolle 3D-E. Sinulla on ainutlaatuinen tilaisuus aloittaa työskentely syksyllä 2026 avautuneessa osastorakennuksessa Jorvin kampuksella.

Mikäli kiinnostuit niin sinua odottaa työ, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ja kehittämään osaamistasi vaativien vatsaelinkirurgisten päivystyspotilaiden parissa. Meillä työskentelet monipuolisessa ja vaativassa erikoissairaanhoidon ympäristössä, jossa hyvä yhteishenki, kollegiaalinen tuki ja jatkuva oppiminen ovat arkipäivää.

Osastollamme hoidetaan päivystyspoliklinikoilta ja valvontayksiköistä siirtyviä vatsaelinkirurgisia päivystyspotilaita. Suurimmat potilasryhmämme ovat umpilisäkkeen poistoon saapuvat potilaat, sappiperäiset vaivat, maha-suolikanavan verenvuodot, haimatulehdukset, suolitukokset sekä selvittelyä ja diagnosointia vaativat vatsakipupotilaat. Teemme myös tiivistä yhteistyötä Jorvin elektiivisen vatsaelinkirurgisen osaston kanssa.

Työnkuva ja tehtävät

Kirurgisen hoitotyön luonne on osastoillamme potilaan pre- ja postoperatiivista hoitotyötä, voinnin systemaattista seurantaa ja arviointia, akuuttien tilanteiden hallintaa, lääke- ja nestehoidon toteuttamista sekä potilasohjausta. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä, jota ohjaa tiivis moniammatillinen yhteistyö ja vahva kollegiaalisuus.

Sairaanhoitajan työ perustuu näyttöön perustuviin hoitotyön käytäntöihin. Vastaat potilaan ja hänen läheistensä yksilöllisten tarpeiden kokonaisvaltaisesta huomioimisesta hoidon suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa ja arvioinnissa. Tuet potilasta ja läheisiä sairauden hoidossa ja siihen sopeutumisessa sekä toteutat lääkehoitoa turvallisesti. Kehität ja ylläpidät osaamistasi aktiivisesti, ohjaat opiskelijoita ja uusia kollegoita sekä hyödynnät sujuvasti teknologiaa ja digitaalisia palveluja. Osallistut näyttöön perustuvien käytäntöjen kehittämiseen ja arviointiin ja teet tiivistä, tavoitteellista yhteistyötä eri ammattiryhmien kanssa potilaan parhaaksi.

  • Merkityksellinen työ erikoissairaanhoidon ytimessä
  • Yksilöllinen perehdytys – olitpa urasi alussa tai kokenut konkari
  • Monipuoliset koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet

title: Battery Modeling Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for invention and self-challenge? Do you thrive on pushing the limits of what’s considered feasible? As part of our Battery Engineering group, you’ll help craft creative battery solutions that deliver more energy in smaller spaces than ever before! You’ll work across disciplines to transform improved hardware elements into a single, integrated design. Join us, and you’ll help us innovate new battery technologies that continually outperform the previous iterations. By collaborating with other product development groups across Apple, you’ll push the industry boundaries of what batteries can do and improve the product experience for our customers across the world.

In this role, you will develop physics-based battery models and model-based algorithms to optimize battery performance, lifetime, and safety across Apple products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • MS degree.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: electrochemical, thermal, or aging modeling of batteries.
  • Experience with numerical methods for solving partial differential equation (PDE) and ordinary differential equation (ODE) systems, such as finite volume, finite element, or stiff ODE/differential-algebraic equation (DAE) solvers, or other methods.
  • Programming experience in MATLAB or Python.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD and 10+ years relevant industry experience.
  • Experience developing production software in C, C++, or Python, including version control (for example, Git), code review, and automated testing.
  • Experience with parameter estimation and numerical optimization.
  • Experience implementing models or algorithms on embedded or resource-constrained systems, including fixed-point arithmetic, memory and compute budgets, or real-time constraints.
  • Experience with model order reduction for distributed parameter systems.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: state estimation (for example, Kalman filtering or observers), model predictive control (MPC), or constrained optimal control.
  • Knowledge of lithium-ion cell production processes, battery test equipment and procedures, and international standards and certification agency.

title: ED Crisis Clinician-Per Diem
description:
ED Crisis Social Worker (Per Diem)

Join our team as an ED Crisis Social Worker at Regions Hospital! You will be joining a dynamic interdisciplinary team of social workers, nurses and providers who truly live our values of partnership, compassion, excellence, and integrity every day! Our focus is to provide compassionate, patient-centered care to meet the needs of our diverse patient population who are experiencing a mental health crisis, and other social support needs.

The ED Crisis Clinician is a licensed mental health professional who provides essential front-line support within the Emergency Department at Regions Hospital. In addition to direct clinical care, the ED Crisis Clinician serves as a key resource to the interdisciplinary team, offering consultation on the psychosocial dimensions of patient care. scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Mandatory

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

3+ years of hands‑on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end‑to‑end validation.

Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

In‑depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred

title: ED Crisis Clinician-Per Diem
description:
ED Crisis Social Worker (Per Diem)

Join our team as an ED Crisis Social Worker at Regions Hospital! You will be joining a dynamic interdisciplinary team of social workers, nurses and providers who truly live our values of partnership, compassion, excellence, and integrity every day! Our focus is to provide compassionate, patient-centered care to meet the needs of our diverse patient population who are experiencing a mental health crisis, and other social support needs.

The ED Crisis Clinician is a licensed mental health professional who provides essential front-line support within the Emergency Department at Regions Hospital. Working independently in a fast-paced clinical environment, the clinician delivers immediate crisis assessment, intervention, and short-term therapeutic support to individuals and families experiencing mental health emergencies.

Core responsibilities include conducting comprehensive clinical assessments, formulating individualized intervention and referral plans, and determining appropriate levels of care. All services are delivered through a trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and patient-centered lens.

In addition to direct clinical care, the ED Crisis Clinician serves as a key resource to the interdisciplinary team, offering consultation on the psychosocial dimensions of patient care. This role is vital in fostering a collaborative, responsive, and compassionate care environment aligned with the organization’s mission and values.

Work Schedule:

Per Diem, Evening/Night shift

Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Counseling or other mental health profession
  • 2 or more years of clinical experience in mental health setting
  • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)- MN Board of Social Work OR Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist (LMFT)- MN Board of Marriage and Family Therapy OR Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC)- MN Board of Behavioral Health & Therapy OR Licensed Psychologist (LP)- MN Board of Psychology

Benefits: Regions Hospital offers a competitive benefits package (.5 FTE or greater) that includes medical insurance, dental insurance, 401K with match, disability insurance, fertility coverage and tuition reimbursement. We offer an on-site employee fitness center, as well as on-site employee clinic to make it more convenient for our staff to get the care they need. We also have a Center for Employee Resilience that provides support and evidence-based practices to bring relief and build resiliency. Regions Hospital is a qualified non-profit employer under the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. Regions is also proud to be a Beyond the Yellow Ribbon Company.
